Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Friday. We’re excited to pilot Redwood for model-serving in our accelerator cohort. One ask from our finance team: can Redwood make an exception to the standard promo-credit bucketing so we can receive a small onboarding stipend (USD 8,000 of free credits) upfront and a second tranche on milestone (after cohort week 4)?

Typical accelerator procurement prefers a PO + invoice path rather than immediate card billing. If you can issue an invoice for the initial stipend and apply the promo credit as a pre-paid line item, that would help us make a faster internal approval.

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the SOW and context — this is doable but will need a small carveout from our standard promo ops. Quick answers up-front:

- We can split the onboarding stipend into two tranches (USD 8k upfront, USD 8k on milestone).
- For upfront invoicing + pre-paid credit line, we typically require a PO and a short billing addendum (finance approval).
- Legal generally does not need to redline for standard stipend splits, but for any change to the T&Cs I’ll need approval from contracts.

To move quickly I’ll: (1) loop in Ben from RevOps to confirm invoicing flow & minimums; (2) prepare a one-page billing addendum that attaches to your SOW and tags the credits as a prepaid line with a 6-month expiry. Can you confirm the billing entity and the PO number you expect? Also copied a stub invoice (invoice-stub.pdf) for reference — once Ben confirms we can route to procurement.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
